title: Hotels with an Acropolis view: which room to book
metaDescription: Seven Athens hotels that sell rooms with an Acropolis view, the exact room category to book, and the look-alike rooms that don't come with the view.
h1: Hotels with an Acropolis view, and which room to book
dek: Seven Athens hotels that sell rooms facing the Acropolis and the Parthenon. For each one we list the exact room category to book, and the garden, city and courtyard rooms to skip.
teaser: From a five-star on Syntagma Square to three-star rooms with a balcony.

decoder.text: At the Grande Bretagne, a plain Deluxe room is sold with a city view. Only the categories with “Acropolis” in the name face the hill. Hotels.com lists the Deluxe Acropolis room in three versions, by bed type and floor.
At the Electra Palace, the Premium Room and the Junior Suite are each sold two ways. The Garden View version looks into the garden; the Acropolis View version looks at the hill.
At the Acropolis View Hotel, two Twin Room categories name the view. The Standard Double or Twin Room and the Economy Twin Room don't.

faq.q: Which Athens hotels sell rooms with an Acropolis view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Hotel Grande Bretagne, Electra Palace Athens, COCO-MAT Athens BC, Divani Palace Acropolis, niche Hotel Athens, Plaka Hotel and Acropolis View Hotel. Each sells specific room categories with the view. Their other rooms don't promise it.

faq.q: Does a hotel called “Acropolis View” put every room facing the Acropolis?
faq.a: No. At the Acropolis View Hotel, only two Twin Room categories name the view. Book the category that names it.

faq.q: Which hotel has the most Acropolis view room types?
faq.a: Hotel Grande Bretagne, with six on Hotels.com: three versions of the Deluxe Acropolis room, the Executive Acropolis Suite, the Grand Acropolis Suite and the Penthouse Suite.

faq.q: Is the Parthenon the same view as the Acropolis view?
faq.a: The Parthenon is the temple on top of the Acropolis hill. Hotels sell these rooms as “Acropolis view”, and that is the wording to look for in the room name.
